description: How long since anything arrived from the bank — bank files (camt and the like), their import state, and the payments recorded against them. Answers the question behind 'this has not been reconciled in a while' with dates instead of an impression. It does NOT start a bank sync, and neither does anything else: AbaNinja's API has no endpoint that triggers one — /finances/v2/bank-files is read-only, measured against the vendor specification on 16.09.2026. Files appear because someone imports them or a bank connection delivers them, both outside this API. Read-only.
name: get_abaninja_banking_status
